Recruitment For The New India Assurance

  1. Home
  2. Recruitment

Mr Arpit Potdar

Deputy Manager - TMD, Head office

Having worked in India's premier multinational insurer (New India Assurance) , it gives me immense pride to have worked on providing coverages for India's growth engines- Power plants, Refineries, Dams, Mega Projects etc for assets worth lakhs of crore rupees (multi billion dollars). It is a profile that has given me a multidimensional growth opportunity.

Mr Gaurav Sharma

Deputy Manager & Chief Operating Officer, NIA - Oman

Working abroad with New India Assurance has been a transformative journey. It provided me with unparalleled exposure to diverse markets, cultures, and professional challenges. The experience has honed my problem-solving and leadership skills while enhancing my ability to adapt to dynamic business environments. It has been a deeply rewarding journey, both professionally and personally, and I am grateful for the opportunity to represent the organization on an international platform.

Mr Abhiram Goutham

Manager & Chief Operating Officer, NIA - Abu Dhabi

Serving as COO in Abu Dhabi (New India Assurance) early in my career has been a transformative journey, offering me unparalleled insights into international markets and fostering invaluable cross-cultural collaborations. This unique opportunity has sharpened my professional competencies and profoundly expanded my global perspective. Representing our organization in the UAE a vibrant international business hub has been immensely rewarding, significantly enhancing my personal development and accelerating my career growth in ways I could have never imagined.

Serving as COO in Abu Dhabi (New India Assurance) early in my career has been a transformative journey, offering me unparalleled insights into international markets and fostering invaluable cross-cultural collaborations. Mr Sharad Verma

Deputy Manager, Rajasthan Govt Business Office, NIACL

Working as a relationship manager in the scheme of a size of around 3000 crore, serving 1.34 crore families covering more than 70% population of the state of Rajasthan and handling around 10000 claims per day is a feeling of achievement every single day. As the scheme provides cashless treatment to lacs of hospitalizations, saving lacs of families from financial hardship, working in it gives a sense of existence and proud to be part of such an organisation (New India Assurance) enabling it.

Priya Meachery

Deputy Chief Executive, UK Branch, NIACL

I joined New India Assurance as an Assistant in 1997 and am currently the Deputy Chief Executive at the Company’s prestigious London office. Thanks to my wonderful mentors and the amazing work culture that recognizes and rewards hard work and perseverance. Not to forget the substantial pay & benefits and the job stability in an uncertain world.

Mr Abdul Shukoor KT

Office In Charge, Lakshadweep Office, NIACL

Lakshadweep, a serene archipelago, embodies peace. Its warm and welcoming people make our service even more rewarding. Representing India’s largest General Insurer (New India Assurance) in its smallest UT is an honor. With 70% of the population covered under the AB-PMJAY scheme and all vital transport vessels insured by us, safeguarding the islanders' lives and livelihoods is our privilege and unwavering commitment.
